targets.rawSql: select 100.0*count(*) filter(where state='failed')/nullif(count(*),0) value from dag_run where $__timeFilter(start_date)
select percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by extract(epoch from(end_date-start_date))) value from task_instance where state='success' and $__timeFilter(start_date)
select percentile_cont(0.95) within group(order by extract(epoch from(end_date-start_date))) value from task_instance where state='success' and $__timeFilter(start_date)
select count(*) value from task_instance where try_number>1 and $__timeFilter(start_date)
select start_date time,extract(epoch from(end_date-start_date)) value,dag_id metric from dag_run where end_date is not null and $__timeFilter(start_date) order by start_date
select dag_id,task_id,start_date,end_date,try_number from task_instance where state='failed' and start_date>=now()-interval '7 days' order by start_date desc limit 100
